## Services
- **AI agents & automation** — Claude, Composio, MCP integrations, agentic workflows

- **Brand & design systems** — Figma + Code Connect + multi-target design tokens
- **Marketing & growth engineering** — programmatic SEO, GA4/PostHog/Mixpanel, lifecycle automation

## Engagement model
- 30-minute discovery call (free, no pitch)
- Fixed-scope, fixed-price proposal within 48 hours
- Ship in 2–6 weeks with daily updates and a private client portal
- Typical engagement size: $5k–$30k
